description: Read-only — no spend, no operation started. Estimates the USD cost of running seo_generate_keywords scoped to one language for this brand. 110-multilingual-brand decision 7: keyword research for a specific language is never automatic — always check this first and confirm with the user before calling seo_generate_keywords with that same `language`. Returns pairCount (how many of the brand's configured (location, language) SEO markets share this language) and estimatedCostUsd. pairCount 0 means no market is configured for this language yet — the brand needs one added via SEO market settings before researching it.

language.description: Language to estimate the cost of researching. One of: en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs.

name: seo_estimate_research_cost
